user.title: Select your Ninebot/Xiaomi scooter
user.description: Home Assistant searches for nearby Ninebot and Xiaomi scooters using its built-in Bluetooth stack.

data_description.sensor_groups: Battery, odometer, range and connection are always included. The groups below barely change while the scooter is parked, so they start switched off. You can change this later in the options.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Ninebot/Xiaomi scooter found
bluetooth_confirm.description: Add {name} to Home Assistant? The exact model is detected after the first successful BLE session.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Ninebot/Xiaomi scooter
reconfigure.description: Select the Bluetooth device to use.

init.title: Ninebot/Xiaomi scooter options
init.description: Choose the polling interval and scooter model profile. Automatic detection needs a known full serial number. Controls remain disabled on unverified variants.

retry_scan.title: Rescan for Ninebot/Xiaomi scooter
retry_scan.description: No matching scooter is currently advertising. Submit the empty form to rescan. Only if scanning remains unsuccessful, enter the exact BLE address and advertised name. Scanner error: {scan_error}

error.name_required: Enter the exact broadcast Bluetooth name
error.model_required: Select the model or Ninebot series before adding this device.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported Ninebot/Xiaomi scooter was found nearby.

init.title: Ninebot/Xiaomi scooter options
init.description: Choose the polling interval, the scooter model label and the additional sensors. Settings have not been verified on every variant.

data_description.sensor_groups: Battery, odometer, range and connection are always included. Sensors of a group you untick are removed when you save.
